name: pitchSpeed
meaning: Max pitch rate in angle units/s (mode 0: 300). Also scaled for manual pitch input and doubled (x2) for auto-turn 0x6e43c8.

name: yawSpeed
meaning: Max yaw rate in angle units/s (mode 0: 1500; mode 0xC: 3000). Manual rotation = input*g_dt*yawSpeed*2 >> 20. Also the side-turn rate.

name: pitchRollAccel
meaning: Accel and decel passed to Math_ApproachAngle for pitch and roll in Camera_SmoothToDesired (mode 0: 6144)

name: yawAccel
meaning: Yaw acceleration for Math_ApproachAngle (mode 0: 2048; mode 2 run: 32768)

name: yawDecel
meaning: Yaw deceleration, used when the required velocity is below the current one (mode 0: 6144; mode 2: 32768). The existing g_camModeDefaults comment calls +0xC..+0x17 's16 pairs'; they are three s32, read with 32-bit loads.
